note: Upcoming and past events for the Corporate Sector Intelligence coverage list. Dates come only from company financial calendars and investor-relations pages, exchange calendars, and the Norwegian Offshore Directorate or Ministry of Energy. A confirmed date is a published day. Guidance is a company or official window such as Q1 2027. Dates that have not been published are left out, not estimated. Ex-dividend dates are not included. This log is separate from the Research Coming up calendar.

events.description: The Ministry of Energy announced Awards in Predefined Areas (APA) 2026 on 5 May 2026, covering the North Sea, the Norwegian Sea and the Barents Sea.

events.title: Listing on the TSX Venture Exchange
events.description: Valiente received final approval to list as a Tier 2 mining issuer. Trading starts at the opening of the market on 16 November 2026 under the ticker VALX.

events.title: New NGEx shares start trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange
events.description: Following the Valiente spin-out, the new NGEx shares start trading at the opening of the market on 16 November 2026. The ticker on the Toronto Stock Exchange remains NGEX.

events.title: Dugong final investment decision
events.description: The partnerships are targeting a final investment decision in 2027. Attica holds 15% in Dugong through Concedo. Vår Energi is the operator.

events.title: Dugong production start-up
events.description: The partnerships are targeting production start-up in 2030, after a final investment decision in 2027.
